description: The bar chart illustrates the popularity of different language models—Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball, with popularity measured on a scale from 0 to 220. Each category contains three bars representing the three models, with additional bars showing the performance of models with specific accuracy conditions (Acc=0 & GT Ans, Acc=0 & Gene Ans, Acc=1 & GT Ans), distinguished by different patterns and colors. In the Movies category, Llama3 (blue with diagonal stripes) has a popularity of approximately 30, Qwen2 (red with crosshatch) is around 40, and ChatGPT (yellow with vertical stripes) is about 35, while the accuracy-conditioned bars are lower, with the highest being Acc=1 & GT Ans at around 30. In the Songs category, Llama3's popularity increases to about 60, Qwen2 to 65, and ChatGPT to 70, with the accuracy-conditioned bars again lower, the highest being Acc=1 & GT Ans at approximately 55. In the Basketball category, Llama3 reaches a popularity of about 100, Qwen2 peaks at around 190, and ChatGPT is at approximately 170, with the accuracy-conditioned bars showing a similar trend, the highest being Acc=1 & GT Ans at about 130. The chart demonstrates that Qwen2 generally has the highest popularity, especially in the Basketball category, while the accuracy-conditioned bars are consistently lower across all categories.
